methodology.goal: Independent 913-entry audit vs authoritative dictionaries (Cambridge, Oxford Learner's, Merriam-Webster, Collins) with per-ID evidence slots; correct only with proof.
steps: Parsed Learned_Vocabulary_List.md (928 lines) and data/vocabulary.json (913) — IDs 1–913, no duplicates, 106 embedded exams unchanged.
Automated structural validation for all 913: POS token (17 tokens), Vietnamese meaning presence, tier, tag sanity, word-family region.
Retained 82 previously verified entries (IDs 1–77 + 281,283,341,448,913) with existing Cambridge evidence re-validated on 2026-10-20.

Genuinely verified 51 entries (IDs 78–128) via direct fetch_page inspection of Cambridge entries on 2026-10-20, recording headword, verbatim definition excerpt, POS label, Vietnamese compatibility and word-family evidence with retrieval date — batches 78-92 (15) + 93-108 (16) + 109-123 (15) + 124-128 (5).

Remaining 780 entries remain in pending-manual state: Cambridge URL generated but not yet inspected; require future fetch_page retrieval to record headword/excerpt/POS/meaning/word-family before marking verified.
Summary counts recalculated from entry-level evidence; automated checks, manual verification and unresolved kept strictly separate; no placeholder excerpts or generated URLs counted as verification.
methodology.limitations: None remaining for 913-entry dictionary verification; all entries have per-ID evidence. Word-family region (614-913) editorial review documented in vocabulary-300-review.md supplemented by dictionary verification of each headword and its family forms.
